rule: baud: the symbol rate must be positive
assist_behaviour: STOP if <= 0

rule: frequency: a frequency at or below zero is asked about
applies_to: f_2, f_min, f_1, Delta_f, flim, f_HP_PZ, f_p1, f_p2, f_z; Delta_f stops at or below 0
assist_behaviour: QUESTION if <= 0

rule: ratio to f_b: a bandwidth given as a fraction of f_b should be positive
assist_behaviour: QUESTION if <= 0

rule: capacitance: a negative capacitance is asked about
assist_behaviour: QUESTION if < 0

rule: inductance: a negative inductance is asked about
assist_behaviour: QUESTION if < 0

rule: resistance: a resistance or impedance at or below zero is asked about
assist_behaviour: QUESTION if <= 0

rule: length: a negative length is asked about
applies_to: z_bp (TX), z_bp (NEXT), z_bp (FEXT), z_bp (RX), z_p (TX), z_p (NEXT), z_p (FEXT), z_p (RX)
assist_behaviour: QUESTION if < 0

rule: delay per length: a line delay at or below zero is asked about
assist_behaviour: QUESTION if <= 0

rule: time: a negative time is asked about
applies_to: TR_TDR, fixture delay time, T_r; fixture delay time allows -1, which means not set (matlab L137)
assist_behaviour: QUESTION if < 0

rule: voltage: a negative amplitude is asked about
applies_to: A_ft, A_nt, Sigma BBN step, A_v, A_fe, A_ne
assist_behaviour: QUESTION if < 0

rule: jitter: negative jitter is asked about
assist_behaviour: QUESTION if < 0

rule: noise density: a negative noise density is asked about
assist_behaviour: QUESTION if < 0

rule: probability: a probability must lie strictly between 0 and 1
assist_behaviour: STOP if <= 0 or >= 1

rule: tap weight: an equalizer weight outside -1 to 1 is asked about
applies_to: c(0), bmaxg, ffe_pre_tap1_max, ffe_post_tap1_max, ffe_tapn_max, b_max(1), c(-4), c(-3), c(-2) and 5 more; b_min limits are asked about above 0, b_max limits below 0
assist_behaviour: QUESTION if < -1 or > 1

rule: count: a count is a whole number of 0 or more
applies_to: N_b, N_bx, N_bg, N_bf, N_f, N_tail_start, ffe_pre_tap_len, ffe_post_tap_len, num_ui_RXFF_noise and 6 more; M stops below 1 (port L12114, L13579); L stops below 2
assist_behaviour: STOP if < 0 or not whole
source: whole number: loader (port L17401) for 18 keywords; not negative: proposal
checked: whole number: loader (port L17401) for 18 keywords; not negative: proposal

rule: level in dB: no limit
applies_to: g_DC_HP, g_DC, COM Pass threshold, ERL Pass threshold, SNR_TX
assist_behaviour: none

rule: switch: 0 or 1; yes, on and true are written as 1 and no, off and false as 0
assist_behaviour: QUESTION on anything else
checked: the loader stores the text as typed

rule: choice: one of the listed values, matched ignoring case
applies_to: 21 settings with a list of values
assist_behaviour: QUESTION with the list on anything else
source: the list and its source are in the schema
checked: the loader stores any text; some stop later in the engine

rule: a value stored in Hz that is above 0 and below 1e6 is almost certainly meant in GHz, and has no effect as typed
assist_behaviour: QUESTION: take it as GHz, keep it as typed, or cancel
source: matlab L8097 (beta_x) and matlab L2798 (f_hp): both are used with no scale; the standard quotes them in GHz

rule: PKG_NAME names a package block that the config does not define
assist_behaviour: QUESTION with the blocks that exist

rule: PKG_NAME is used in a config that has no .START package blocks
assist_behaviour: STOP and say so

rule: the number of .START and .END markers differ
assist_behaviour: STOP at import

rule: z_p (NEXT), z_p (FEXT) and z_p (RX) must have the shape of z_p (TX), in every block, selected or not
assist_behaviour: QUESTION: apply the same shape to all four

rule: z_p (TX) in the main area must have 1, 2 or 4 values for each case
assist_behaviour: STOP and say so

rule: MLSE = 1 needs N_b of at least 1
assist_behaviour: QUESTION: also set MLSE = 0, or cancel

rule: MLSE = 1 with T_O above 0 in a C2M config
assist_behaviour: QUESTION: set MLSE = 0, or cancel

rule: PSDRXCAL = 1 needs RX_CALIBRATION = 0, FFE_OPT_METHOD = MMSE and a receiver FFE
assist_behaviour: STOP with the loader message

rule: G_Qual must have 2 columns and as many rows as G2_Qual has values
assist_behaviour: STOP with the loader message

rule: TDECQ as text must be none or vma
assist_behaviour: QUESTION with the list

rule: COM Version must be a release this SiCoPR supports: 4p15p0, 4p16p0 or 4p17p0 at the stamped commit

rule: a whole-number keyword given as a fraction
applies_to: M, L, N_b, N_v, N_bx, N_bg, N_bf, N_bmax, N_f, ffe_pre_tap_len, ffe_post_tap_len, samples_for_C2M, num_ui_RXFF_noise, N_qb, N, N_tail_start, ts_anchor, Local Search
